releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.0.0 (100% Pro Milestone Suite)
changelog:
🎉 Major Pro Milestone Release v10.0.0:
• Step 1: Real In-Place PDF & JPG Text Edit Engine (Auto-OCR, font & size matching, zero-halo inpainting)
• Step 2: Native Excel (.xlsx & .csv) OpenXML Export with table structures
• Step 3: Signature Studio & Official Stamp Engine (Auto-crop, multi-color ink isolation, circular & triangular seals)
• Step 4: ID Card Duplex Scanner & Government ID Redaction (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport auto-masking)
• Step 5: Cloud Backup & Google Drive Integration with offline queueing
• Step 6: Document Filter Suite (Magic Color, B&W, Document Clean, Despeckle)
• Step 7: Watermark, Logo & Legal Bates Numbering Studio
• Step 8: CamScanner Home & Batch Scanning Flow with multi-selection dock
• Step 9: PDF Merge, Split, Reorder, Compress & AES-128 Studio (Custom page ranges, chunk splits)
• Step 10: Seamless External Document Intent Filters (Open & Share from WhatsApp, Gmail, Files)
